title: Reflected Midnight City
description: A solitary dark silhouette of a long-haired woman in a flowing dress stands on a stone shore, gazing at a lake. The water perfectly reflects an inverted nocturnal cityscape with glowing buildings, while the real background shows mountains, a forested shoreline, and illuminated houses under a red moon in a cloudy night sky.
prompt: A mysterious silhouette of a woman in a long dark coat standing on a cobblestone shore at night, looking down at a lake. The water creates a perfect mirror reflection showing an upside-down glowing cyberpunk city with illuminated skyscrapers. In the real world behind her are dark mountains, pine trees, and warm-lit houses under a dramatic cloudy sky with a red full moon casting reflections on the water.
